  "name": "loss_rank_gap_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "Shift from pairwise margin with logsigmoid to a rank-gap paradigm using hyperbolic tangent on advantage signals, leveraging smooth bounded transformation to stabilize gradients and emphasize relative quality differences.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_diff = advantage_w - advantage_l\nscaled = alpha * adv_diff\nloss = mean(weight * (1 - tanh(scaled)))",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_rank_gap",

  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n\n    adv_diff = ops.sub(advantage_w, advantage_l)\n    scaled = ops.mul(alpha, adv_diff)\n    tanh_scaled = ops.tanh(scaled)\n    loss = ops.sub(ops.ones_like(tanh_scaled), tanh_scaled)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = loss * weight\n    return ops.sum(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_rankgap_smoothhinge_advantage",
  "intuition": "Shift from margin-based log-sigmoid loss to a smooth hinge loss on the rank gap weighted by the advantage difference, promoting a calibrated ranking preference with hinge penalties and smooth transitions.",
  "pseudocode": "rank_gap = rank_gap(lpw - lpl)  # positive if w better\nadvantage_diff = advantage_w - advantage_l\nmargin = 1.0\nhinge_loss = relu(margin - rank_gap * advantage_diff)\nloss = mean(weight * hinge_loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "hinge_smooth",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "relu_margin"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "rank_gap",
    "relu",
    "mean",
    "mul",
    "sub"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    margin = float(extra.get('margin', 1.0))\n    gap = ops.rank_gap(lpw - lpl)\n    adv_diff = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    hinge_input = ops.sub(margin, ops.mul(gap, adv_diff))\n    loss = ops.relu(hinge_input)\n    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)"
}

  "intuition": "Introducing scale-invariance by normalizing the margin by stable sequence length difference plus epsilon, falling back safely if seq_len keys missing.",
  "pseudocode": "eps=1e-6; margin = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / (abs(seq_len_w - seq_len_l) + eps); loss = -logsigmoid(clamp(alpha * scale * margin - 0.1 * cost_gap, -20, 20)) weighted mean",

  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    eps = 1e-6\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))\n    cost_gap = batch.get('cost_gap', None)\n    if cost_gap is None:\n        zeros = lpw.new_zeros(lpw.shape)\n        cost_gap = batch.get('cost_b', zeros) - batch.get('cost_a', zeros)\n    seq_len_w = batch.get('seq_len_w', None)\n    seq_len_l = batch.get('seq_len_l', None)\n    if seq_len_w is None or seq_len_l is None:\n        # fallback denominator = 1 to avoid division error\n        denom = lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape)\n    else:\n        denom = ops.abs(seq_len_w - seq_len_l) + eps\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    margin = (lpw - lpl) / denom\n    x = alpha * scale * margin - 0.1 * cost_gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    loss = loss * weight\n    return loss.mean()\n"

  "pseudocode": "adv_diff = advantage_w - advantage_l\nscaled_delta_regret = clamp(delta_regret, 0, 5)\nlp_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l\nweighted_diff = adv_diff * lp_diff * scaled_delta_regret\nloss = mean(weight * relu(-logsigmoid(weighted_diff)))",
  "hyperparams": {

    "signal_family": "advantage_and_delta_regret",

    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    eps = 1e-8\n    log_prob_w = batch['log_prob_w']\n    log_prob_l = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(log_prob_w))\n    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    delta_regret = batch.get('delta_regret', ops.zeros_like(log_prob_w))\n\n    adv_diff = ops.sub(advantage_w, advantage_l)\n    delta_regret_clamped = ops.clamp(delta_regret, 0.0, 5.0)\n    lp_diff = ops.sub(log_prob_w, log_prob_l)\n    weighted_diff = ops.mul(ops.mul(adv_diff, lp_diff), delta_regret_clamped)\n\n    loss_raw = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(weighted_diff))\n    loss = ops.relu(loss_raw)\n    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n\n    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)"

  "name": "loss_advantage_ratio_log_clamped_repaired",
  "intuition": "Repaired the loss to remove dependency on missing keys 'advantage_w' and 'advantage_l' by replacing advantage ratio with a ratio based on the available 'advantage_gap' plus eps (1e-8). This fixes the missing key failure by relying only on present data keys.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_ratio = (advantage_gap + epsilon) / 1.0\nprob_ratio = exp(log_prob_w - log_prob_l)\nloss_raw = -log(clamp(adv_ratio * prob_ratio, min=1e-6, max=10))\nloss = mean(weight * loss_raw)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_advantage_ratio",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "log_clamp",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "clamp_stabilized"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "exp",

    "add",
    "mean",
    "neg"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    eps = 1e-8\n\n    # Use advantage_gap to avoid missing advantage_w/l\n    adv_ratio = ops.div(ops.add(adv_gap, eps), 1.0)\n    prob_ratio = ops.exp(ops.sub(lpw, lpl))\n    combined = ops.mul(adv_ratio, prob_ratio)\n    combined_clamped = ops.clamp(combined, 1e-6, 10.0)\n    loss = ops.neg(ops.log(combined_clamped))\n\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

  "hyperparams": {

    "signal_family": "advantage_w",

    "mode": "pairwise"

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 2.0)))\n\n    adv_diff = ops.sub(advantage_l, advantage_w)\n    scaled_sigmoid = ops.sub(ops.mul(2, ops.sigmoid(ops.mul(beta, adv_diff))), 1)\n    weighting = ops.add(scaled_sigmoid, 1)\n    loss_w = ops.mul(ops.neg(weighting), lpw)\n    loss_l = ops.mul(weighting, lpl)\n    loss = ops.mean(ops.mul(weight, ops.add(loss_w, loss_l)))\n    return loss",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    eps = 1e-8\n    lpw = batch[\"log_prob_w\"]\n    lpl = batch[\"log_prob_l\"]\n    weight = batch[\"weight\"]\n    advantage_w = batch[\"advantage_w\"]\n    margin = 0.1\n    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    margin_diff = ops.sub(diff, margin)\n    neg_margin_diff = ops.neg(margin_diff)\n    exp_term = ops.exp(neg_margin_diff)\n    # softplus = log(1 + exp(-margin_diff)) with numeric stability\n    softplus = ops.log(ops.add(exp_term, ops.ones_like(exp_term)).clamp(min=eps))\n    weighted_loss = ops.mul(weight, ops.mul(advantage_w, softplus))\n    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)",

  "name": "loss_advantage_ratio_log_clamped_symmetric_norm",
  "intuition": "Injects a symmetry and explicit normalization constraint by symmetrizing the advantage ratio loss and normalizing the final scalar output to ensure scale invariance and balanced treatment of both orderings in the preference pair.",
